integrity: The proof is a direct monotonicity-and-sandwich argument plus an explicit nested-substructure construction for the canonical equivalence-structure family. Literature comparison is bounded; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a no-go result for Scott-continuous maps from positive-diagram spaces to P(N) with E0 as target. It does not rule out Cantor-continuous reductions on full atomic diagrams or characterize all positive-data learning classes.
title: A nested-copy obstruction to Scott-continuous \(E_0\) reduction
